title: Gather Service State
description: Waits for every part a Spread sent on and turns them back into one value — as an array, or as whatever its nested pipeline makes of them. (Runtimes: browser, node, python, cpp; IDs: gather)

pipeline.description: The nested services that make one value of { group, items }; none passes the items on as an array

maxBytes.description: The most one group may hold (64 MiB, the coordinator's default frame limit)

maxGroups.description: How many groups may be incomplete at once

timeoutMs.description: How long a group may take to complete

stopPropagation.description: Pass nothing on, even a complete group

pending.description: Read-only: how many groups are incomplete

error.description: Read-only: the last group refused or let go, and why
